missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Горе' is the neuter nominative subject of 'постигло'. 'Большое' is the agreeing neuter adjective, and 'их' is the accusative object.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Горе' is the accusative direct object of 'пережила'; for this neuter noun the accusative matches the nominative. 'Страшное' agrees in the neuter.

missions.phrase: От горя она не могла говорить.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive after от. 'Горя' takes the genitive after 'от' to express the cause of a state. The phrase shows grief preventing her from speaking.
Strategic focus: Dative after сочувствовать. 'Горю' is in the dative case as the object of 'сочувствуем', which governs the dative. 'Их' marks whose grief it is.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of cause. 'Горем' takes the instrumental case to express the agent of the state 'убита'. The phrase means she was overcome by grief.

missions.phrase: В её горе мы не одиноки.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional after в. 'Горе' is in the prepositional case after 'в' to mark the situation shared. 'Её' shows whose grief, and 'мы' is nominative.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject with accusative object. 'Горе' is the neuter nominative subject of 'сблизило', and 'всю семью' is the accusative object brought together.
Strategic focus: Genitive after сколько. 'Горя' takes the genitive after the quantity word 'сколько'. 'Этот народ' is the nominative subject of 'пережил'.
Strategic focus: Genitive after много. 'Горя' takes the genitive after 'много' to express a great amount. 'Война' is nominative, and 'людям' is the dative recipient.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Горе' is the accusative direct object of 'лечит'; the neuter accusative matches the nominative. 'Любое' agrees, and 'время' is the nominative subject.
